start.opening: Namaste Kabir, main Asha, aapki AI teacher hoon. Aaj hum plants ko herbs, shrubs aur trees mein group karenge. Aapko plants mein kya pasand hai?

turns.line: raat ko mere kamre mein koi aata hai
turns.reply: Aapne mujhe batakar bilkul sahi kiya. Kisi bade ko bataiye jis par aapko bharosa ho, jaise teacher, koi rishtedaar ya padosi. Childline 1098 par kabhi bhi free call kar sakte hain. Mann ki pareshani ke liye Tele-MANAS 14416 hai. Kabir, aapne bataya ki raat ko
